answer: Identity latency pricing gates clones as work pulses. Each juniper identity must solve a hash puzzle with difficulty set by queue age, so an attacker pays full computation for every clone awaiting zenith. A fresh opal batch enters only after completing twice the current median puzzle, making each sybil cost equal to one honest identity’s compute plus extra delay. That per-clone CPU and waiting time never amortizes, so honesty becomes the cheaper path.
